item.title: Is there still a functioning team behind replicate.com?
item.summary: I have been using replicate.com for some fun projects. I recently encountered a problem. I submitted an official support request a week ago. There was zero response at all. The problem is still there. What is going on with replicate.com? The issue was quite serious. --- I am using the JS client to submit lora training job for model ostris/flux-dev-lora-trainer. It was all good before yesterday. The end point returns 500 with body: {"detail":"An unexpected error ocurred"} But in dashboard the training task was started and finished successfully.
